description: Get one task with its full description, steps (subtasks), progress, labels and the latest notes. Returns status, priority, project, the numbered steps with ids (each with its description and, once done, its summary), up to 10 latest notes, the completion summary and what changed (files, checks, links, risks, how to verify) when it was reported. An unknown task_id fails with "Task not found"; get a valid id from taskhold_list (status "all") or taskhold_search.

task_id.description: The ID of the task to retrieve

name: taskhold_get
title: Get a task
